prose: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Argon, its long-awaited next-generation model, first to a small group of trusted cybersecurity partners through a program called Fairwind. Axios reports Google also says it is taking part in the US government's voluntary pre-release process. Based on the Techmeme excerpt.
highlights: Gemini 4 Argon goes first to trusted cyber defenders
Google joins the voluntary US pre-release process
